jobs.name: ExecuTorch weekly shortlist
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm shortlist mode. Collect 20 eligible issues, archive in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/, present to the user and wait for selection. Never start development or write to community repositories.

jobs.name: ExecuTorch daily PR progress
jobs.prompt: Use executorch-pm PR check mode. Read tracked and authored ExecuTorch PR progress, save a dated snapshot in yenhao-huang/daily executorch/<time>/, and notify only on meaningful changes, completion, failure or required user action. Stay quiet on unchanged states. Never write to community repositories or trigger development.
